note: Work: 16. Employment Act (Act No 2/2008), in the English translation the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade publishes: minors under sixteen shall not be employed except in training linked to their education, and minors under sixteen in the family's own line of work are exempt (s. 6); a minor may work only with the guardian's consent, not in school hours or after 11 p.m. (ss. 8, 9): not held. The Labour Relations Authority's consolidated translation to 21 September 2022 wasn't compared. Performers: barred, the reading being that s. 6 has no exception for performers. Majority: null; the Act says a child is under eighteen under Law No 9/91 (rights of the child), which isn't the age of majority in law, and mvlaw.gov.mv's legislation API answers 'Unauthenticated' to this client (2026-10-31). Service: null; the Armed Forces Act (Law No 1/2008) wasn't read.

sources.title: Ministry of Economic Development and Trade (Maldives): Employment Act, Act No 2/2008 (English translation)
sources.said: Minors under the age of sixteen years shall not be employed except in ... connection with training associated with their education or ... the family's line of work of their own shall be exempted from this ... A child shall be deemed to be under eighteen
